/*entities link colors*/
/**entities page link animation**/
a[href="/wiki/Entities"] {
    animation: entities 8s infinite;
}
@keyframes entities {
    0% { 
        color: #3333FF;
        text-shadow: 0 0 2.5px #3333FF, 0 0 2.5px #3333FF, 0 0 2.5px #3333FF;
    }
    5% { 
        color: #00FF66 ;
        text-shadow: 0 0 2.5px #00FF66, 0 0 2.5px  #00FF66, 0 0 2.5px  #00FF66;
    }
    15% { 
        color: #940002;
        text-shadow: 0 0 2.5px #940002, 0 0 2.5px #940002, 0 0 2.5px #940002;
    }
    35% { 
        color: blue;
        text-shadow: 0 0 2.5px black, 0 0 2.5px  black, 0 0 2.5px  black;
    }
    50% { 
        color: #01FFFF;
        text-shadow: 0 0 2.5px #0097FF, 0 0 2.5px  #0097FF, 0 0 2.5px  #0097FF;
    }
    65% { 
        color: #EA0CF5;
        text-shadow: 0 0 2.5px #EA0CF5, 0 0 2.5px  #EA0CF5, 0 0 2.5px  #EA0CF5;
    }
    80% { 
        color: white;
        text-shadow: 0 0 2.5px white, 0 0 2.5px  white, 0 0 2.5px  white;
    }
    100% { 
        color: #3333FF;
        text-shadow: 0 0 2.5px #3333FF, 0 0 2.5px #3333FF, 0 0 2.5px #3333FF;
    } 
}
/**end of entities page link animation**/

/*user icon next to name*/
/**set up**/
[class^='EntityHeader_name__']::after,
[class^='mw-userlink']::after,
.edit-info-user::after,
.lastEdited > a:after {
	display: inline-block;
	margin-left: 6px;
	width: 16px;
	height: 16px;
	background-size: cover;
	vertical-align: sub;
}
.edit-info-user::after {
	margin-left: 0;
	width: 12px;
	height: 12px;
	transform: translate(0px, -1px);
}
/**end of set up**/

/***Bureaucrats***/
/* https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/csydes-test/images/9/95/Fandom_Helper_Badge_Gold_Recolour.svg */

	content: '';
	background-image: url(https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/csydes-test/images/9/95/Fandom_Helper_Badge_Gold_Recolour.svg);

/*Things to make wiki look better, credits to IR wiki for some code*/
/**gallery outline**/
.wikia-gallery-item .thumb .gallery-image-wrapper { 
	border: 3px solid #666666;
    border-radius: 4px; 
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px #666666;
    background: rgba(var(--theme-page-background-color--rgb), 0.74);
}
.wikia-gallery-caption-below .lightbox-caption {
  text-align: center;
  text-shadow: 0 0 5px #666666, 0 0 5px #666666, 0 0 5px #666666;;
}
/**end of gallery outline**/

/**tabber design**/
.wds-tabs__wrapper .wds-tabs, .tabber .wds-tabs__wrapper .wds-tabs {
	border-radius: 15px;
    border: 2px solid #666666;
}
.wds-tabs .wds-tabs__tab-label, .tabber .wds-tabs .wds-tabs__tab-label {
	margin: 0;
    font-weight: 100 !important;
}
.wds-tabs__wrapper.with-bottom-border {
    border-bottom: transparent !important;
}
.theme-fandomdesktop-dark .wds-tabs__tab, .theme-fandomdesktop-dark .tabber .wds-tabs__tab a {
    border-radius: 15px;
	background: rgba(var(--theme-page-background-color--rgb), 0.74);
    border: 2px solid #666666;
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: bold;
    text-shadow: 0 0 5px #666666, 0 0 5px #666666, 0 0 5px #666666;
    font-family: Silkscreen;
}
.theme-fandomdesktop-light .wds-tabs__tab, .theme-fandomdesktop-light .tabber .wds-tabs__tab a {
	border-radius: 15px;
	background: rgba(var(--theme-page-background-color--rgb), 0.74);
    border: 2px solid #666666;
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: bold;
    text-shadow: 0 0 5px #666666, 0 0 5px #666666, 0 0 5px #666666;
    font-family: Silkscreen;
}
/**end of tabber design**/

/**infoboxs design**/
.portable-infobox img { 
   transition: all .5s ease
}
.portable-infobox img { 
   transition: all .5s ease
}
.portable-infobox img:hover {
   filter: brightness(135%);
   transform: scaleY(.95) scaleX(.95)
}
.portable-infobox img:hover {
   filter: brightness(135%);
   transform: scaleY(.95) scaleX(.95)
}
.portable-infobox {
	background: rgba(var(--theme-page-background-color--rgb), 0.74);
	--pi-secondary-background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) linear-gradient(to bottom, #333333, #666666) repeat scroll 0 0;
    border: 12px double #666666;
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px #666666;
}
.pi-title {
	font-size: 150% !important;
	text-align: center;
	font-weight: bold;
	text-shadow: 0 0 5px #666666, 0 0 5px #666666, 0 0 5px #666666;
}
.pi-header {
	font-size: 135% !important;
	text-align: center;
	font-weight: bold;
    text-shadow: 0 0 5px #666666, 0 0 5px #666666, 0 0 5px #666666;
}
.pi-caption {
  text-shadow: 0 0 5px #666666, 0 0 5px #666666, 0 0 5px #666666;
}
/**end of infoboxs design**/

/**page design**/
.page  {
	border-top-left-radius:15px !important;
    border-top-right-radius:15px !important;
    border-bottom-left-radius:15px !important;
    border-bottom-right-radius:15px !important;
    border: 5px solid #666666 !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 35px #666666 , inset 0 0 35px #666666;
}
.page__right-rail {
  background: rgba(var(--theme-page-background-color--rgb), 0.79);
  border-top-right-radius:15px !important;
  border-bottom-right-radius:15px !important;
}
.rail-module {
	background: rgba(var(--theme-page-background-color--rgb), 0.74);
	border-radius: 15px;
    border: 4px solid #666666 !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px #666666, inset 0 0 20px #666666;
